NativeInputAndReadback: Read only supplied small source tables/receipts. Native MAT/CSV/XLSX compatibility checked with constructed or already generated synthetic sources; no historical real workbooks opened.

ReviewSelectionPersistence: Existing batch UI state, or a separate compact-selection sidecar beside the batch CSV. Bind exact batch/automatic source/review snapshot identities and hashes; no scientific CSV/result/review edits. Explicit source change invalidates incompatible remembered selection.
UnavailableReviewedRule: No compatible reviewed snapshot means unavailable reviewed cells. Compatible unchanged saved reviewed values are copied with No manual review. No automatic fallback or review application in this exporter.
LegacyAndR31PolicyRule: Copy actual saved values/version, including signed negatives and genuine missingness. Do not adopt R31 by relabelling an older source. Any real source regeneration is a separate upstream step.
SourceContractMappingFreeze: CEX-01 freezes exact fields/aliases, definitions, read whitelist and selected identities before numerical runs; no data inspection or calculator call during this planning task.

StoppingCondition: Eight-family acceptance complete, or any source/effort/repair/attempt/resource boundary. No automatic next campaign, real batch export, extra run, package, Git transport or release.
